coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Z is the central axis (datum A). X and Y are radial. Datum B is the right planar face establishing the +Z direction reference.

features.name: Central threaded bore
features.description: Central through-hole with internal threads and countersinks on both near and far sides. Serves as Datum A.

features.name: Central hub boss
features.description: Inner central cylindrical hub that connects to the spokes.

features.name: Top outer radius
features.description: Convex radius on the upper outer corner of the profile.

features.name: Lip width step
features.description: Small vertical face or step width on the protruding lip.

features.name: Bottom outer radius
features.description: Convex radius on the lower outer corner of the lip.

features.name: Inner fillet
features.description: Concave fillet transitioning from the protruding lip into the main part body.

features.name: Main Body
features.description: Wheel-like locker component featuring an outer rim and four radial spokes in a cross pattern.

features.name: Sector Cutouts
features.description: Four large sector-shaped through-pockets that define the spokes of the wheel.

features.name: Wheel-like component
features.description: Overall part geometry consisting of an outer rim, three radial spokes, and a central cylindrical hub with a through bore.

features.name: Radial spokes
features.description: Four radial spokes connecting the inner hub to the outer ring.

features.name: Hub/spoke fillets
features.description: Fillet radii at the interior corners where the four spokes meet the central hub.

features.name: Outer body cylinder
features.description: Overall outer cylindrical envelope of the locker.

features.name: Entry step bore
features.description: First shallow internal step at the left face.

features.name: Main cavity bore
features.description: Deepest internal cylindrical bore ending at the central web.

features.name: Center through hole
features.description: Central bore passing entirely through the internal web.

features.name: Right side face
features.description: Rightmost flat face of the part defining Datum B.

features.name: Right side lobes
features.description: Cutouts or scalloped lobes on the right side of the part.

features.name: Internal dividing web
features.description: Solid material wall separating the left deep cavity from the right pockets.

relationships.detail: Central hub boss shares axis with the central threaded bore (datum A).
Entry step bore is shown on the section cut as centered on the same Z-axis as datum A.
Main cavity bore shares the central axis with datum A.
Center through hole in section A-A is on the same axis as datum A.
Datum B right face is controlled perpendicular to datum A.
Section A-A F2 position callout references datum A.
Section A-A F2 position callout references datum B.
Section A-A F3 position callout references datum A.
Section A-A F3 position callout references datum B.
Four spokes patterned equally around the datum A axis.
Four sector cutouts patterned about the datum A axis.

datums.description: Central axis of the main threaded bore.
Rightmost flat face of the part.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: A is the primary datum axis defined by the central threaded bore; B is a secondary planar datum perpendicular to A. Section A-A shows position tolerances to A|B.

feature_graph.part_notes: Material: AL 7075-T7351 IAW ASTM B-221. Material standard: ASTM B-221. Heat treatment: none specified. Coating: (al) SULFURIC ANODIZE NATURAL PER MIL-A-8625C TYPE II, CLASS 1.. General notes: TOLERANCE: ALL DIMENTIONS ARE AFTER TREATMENTS AND COATINGS.. INSPECTION: INSPECT WITH GO/NOGO GAGE FOR 3B CLASS THREAD. INSPECT FULL LENGTH OF THREAD. INSPECT FROM BOTH SIDES. 100% INSPECTION IS REQUIRED.. DEBURR: EDGES R0.5 MAX OR CHAMFER 0.5X45° MAX. TOLERANCE: INSIDE CORNERS R0.25 MAX. TOLERANCE: ALL DIMENSIONS ARE AFTER COATING.

clarifications.question: The central hole is shown as 3-56 UNF (Ø2.11) THRU in the front view (main_view_front:F1) but as an unthreaded Ø4.4 THRU hole in Section A-A (section_a_a:F4). Which specification is correct for the central hole?

assumptions.text: Grouped isometric_view_1:F2 with main_view_front:F1 as the same central hole based on spatial context and alignment; used main_view_front:F1 as canonical due to explicit dimensions and datum A definition.
Grouped isometric_view_1:F3 with main_view_front:F2 as the same central hub boss; canonical set to main_view_front:F2 which carries the diameter.
Did not group section_a_a:F4 with the central threaded bore group because its Ø4.4 size conflicts with the 3-56 UNF (Ø2.11) thread; treated as a distinct feature pending clarification.

Left all Detail B features (detail_b:F1–F4) as singletons because the parent section does not identify a specific host feature via cross_ref_labels; they likely belong to the entry lip region but there is insufficient certainty to merge.
Coaxial relationships between section_a_a internal bores/holes (F2, F3, F4) and datum A were asserted from section-cut geometry and axis annotations (axis_direction=Z).
Set the coordinate system primary axis to Z with origin along datum A, consistent across isometric and orthographic notes.
Used radial_pattern relationships for the spokes (main_view_front:F3) and the sector cutouts (isometric_view_1:F4) about the datum A axis based on their 4X count and visual symmetry.
Set the right-side lobe/cutout radius features to 4X R2.5 to match the four-spoke layout.
Set the Detail B lip features to apply 360° around the entry lip.
The 3-56 UNF - 3B (Ø2.11) THRU specification in the front view correctly defines the central threaded hole, whereas the Ø4.4 dimension in Section A-A specifies the outer diameter of the central boss.
